name: Radar Amplifier - Flurry Strike
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized ST positioner that allows ally STs to gain positions and guide missiles to accurately hit targets within range. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Flurry Strike capability.

61183.name: TacW Guidance II · Flurry Strike
61183.SpecificEffects:
Enables the ST's adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area to become a valid attack zone for allies' Missile and Rocket attacks.
When launching Flurry Strike or Gusty Strike, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
